title: Shared data for channel.billing_* events
description: Monthly fee per WhatsApp number in BRL (monthly anniversary cycle, debited from the prepaid wallet). Envelope business_id and channel_id identify the number. Money values are integer strings in micros (millionths of BRL); timestamps are UTC ISO 8601.

billing_state.description: grace: fee overdue but the number still sends until grace_until; suspended: outbound sends answer 402 CHANNEL_BILLING_SUSPENDED (inbound keeps working).

current_period_end.description: End of the open cycle (next renewal).

amount_due_micros.description: Overdue fees of this number (past_due). Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

available_micros.description: Wallet available balance at the time of the event. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

monthly_fee_micros.description: Effective monthly fee for this number (default or custom price). Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").
